title: Infernux v0.4.3 · Faster Frames, Complete Players
summary: 0.4.3 brings the editor, animation authoring and cross-platform Players through a sustained real-game validation cycle. The focus is a correct, efficient main path: less repeated frame work, complete startup preparation, consistent asset identities and usable editing tools.

items.title: Reuse published component bindings, scene cameras, lights, shader classifications and asset catalogs instead of repeating discovery and filesystem work every frame.
items.text: Reuse published component bindings, scene cameras, lights, shader classifications and asset catalogs instead of repeating discovery and filesystem work every frame.

items.title: Reduce Python lifecycle dispatch, editor status synchronization, change-journal traversal, native pose submissions and allocation overhead. Leave automatic garbage collection in control of ordinary frame-loop collection.
items.text: Reduce Python lifecycle dispatch, editor status synchronization, change-journal traversal, native pose submissions and allocation overhead. Leave automatic garbage collection in control of ordinary frame-loop collection.

items.title: Complete declared startup work, material preparation and GPU uploads before revealing gameplay. Loading and GPU preparation no longer advance gameplay clocks or consume the first simulation delta.
items.text: Complete declared startup work, material preparation and GPU uploads before revealing gameplay. Loading and GPU preparation no longer advance gameplay clocks or consume the first simulation delta.

items.title: Show independent Play progress only in the editor, using the same presentation as build progress; packaged Players do not open the editor progress window.
items.text: Show independent Play progress only in the editor, using the same presentation as build progress; packaged Players do not open the editor progress window.

items.title: Keep the editor running when an asset cannot be loaded, including damaged initial scenes and files containing bytes from the wrong format. Failed assets use a generic file icon and a Delete/Cancel dialog; cancellation preserves the original file without attempting repairs or restoring cached content over it.
items.text: Keep the editor running when an asset cannot be loaded, including damaged initial scenes and files containing bytes from the wrong format. items.title: Keep failed files visible with their original GUID during live imports. Wait for an actual source change instead of retrying identical invalid content, and close an obsolete error dialog after a successful reimport.
items.text: Keep failed files visible with their original GUID during live imports. Wait for an actual source change instead of retrying identical invalid content, and close an obsolete error dialog after a successful reimport.

items.title: Remove the experimental Cython packaging path. Engine wheels and Player builds use the supported Python/native architecture without an additional Cython build dependency.
items.text: Remove the experimental Cython packaging path. Engine wheels and Player builds use the supported Python/native architecture without an additional Cython build dependency.

items.title: Repair 2D Animation Clip atlas selection, sprite-frame metadata, save operations and previews, and compact the editor layout. Sprite frame selection uses an appropriate numeric control.
items.text: Repair 2D Animation Clip atlas selection, sprite-frame metadata, save operations and previews, and compact the editor layout. Sprite frame selection uses an appropriate numeric control.

items.title: Route Ctrl+S to the visible editable document when another panel owns keyboard focus, preserving animation, scene and UI document ownership.
items.text: Route Ctrl+S to the visible editable document when another panel owns keyboard focus, preserving animation, scene and UI document ownership.

items.title: Add multi-clip animation groups and improve state-machine editing, list controls, localized actions and direct directional transition links.
items.text: Add multi-clip animation groups and improve state-machine editing, list controls, localized actions and direct directional transition links.

items.title: Correct animation transitions, pose-stack bone masks, repeated pose publication and frame-zero events. Sprite, skeletal and grouped playback dispatch the first sample consistently.
items.text: Correct animation transitions, pose-stack bone masks, repeated pose publication and frame-zero events. Sprite, skeletal and grouped playback dispatch the first sample consistently.

items.title: Preserve selections and scene identities through editing, Play/Stop restoration and runtime scene changes.
items.text: Preserve selections and scene identities through editing, Play/Stop restoration and runtime scene changes.

items.title: Repair Game view mouse capture after Escape and Alt+Tab. Process game input before editor Escape handling, with explicit input-edge consumption for in-game menus.

items.title: Make Console single-click selection target the originating object and double-click navigation open the relevant source location. Present project exceptions consistently and navigate to the deepest project call.

items.title: Retain unchanged Canvas geometry, layout contexts and screen-UI command packets, with invalidation scoped to actual hierarchy, visibility and texture dependencies.
items.text: Retain unchanged Canvas geometry, layout contexts and screen-UI command packets, with invalidation scoped to actual hierarchy, visibility and texture dependencies.

items.title: Batch compatible clipped text and atlas-backed images while preserving material, texture and draw-order boundaries. Correct text publication, font invalidation and authored atlas sizing across platforms.
items.text: Batch compatible clipped text and atlas-backed images while preserving material, texture and draw-order boundaries. Correct text publication, font invalidation and authored atlas sizing across platforms.

items.title: Reduce editor panel bookkeeping and avoid unnecessary HUD layout and semantic capture work during normal gameplay.
items.text: Reduce editor panel bookkeeping and avoid unnecessary HUD layout and semantic capture work during normal gameplay.

items.title: Declare only the particle descriptor sets actually used by each pass, avoiding Android device descriptor limits. Repair mobile text, input and rendering publication paths exercised by real-device testing.

items.title: Ship refreshed official MCP, Windows, Linux, Android and Web packages. Each platform package includes its precompiled Player payload; plugin installation does not require a user-managed compiler or toolchain download. Android SDK/device setup remains a separate build prerequisite.
